{
  "pattern_id": "P-LIT-SMELL-REPAIR",
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "rationale": "The workflow performs Go tests across multiple platforms but does not utilize caching for the Go module cache. Implementing actions/cache@v4 keyed by the OS and go.sum (the dependency lockfile) will allow for faster subsequent runs by reusing downloaded dependencies, addressing the configuration smell of missing dependency caching.",
  "workflow_yaml": "on:
  push: null
  pull_request: null
  workflow_dispatch: null
jobs:
  test:
    strategy:
      matrix:
        go-version: [1.22.x]
        platform: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest, windows-latest]
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.platform }}
    steps:
      - name: checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: setup
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: ${{ matrix.go-version }}
          cache: true
      - name: test
        uses: nick-invision/retry@v3
        with:
          max_attempts: 3
          timeout_minutes: 10
          command: go test -v -race -count=1 -coverprofile test.cover ./...
"
}
